combat_progression.rationale: Multiple enemy types, collision scoring, lives, game over, and escalating difficulty are implemented and partially runtime-verified.
evidence: src/main.js:217-232 defines drone, zig, and heavy enemies with varied speed, drift, and health.
src/main.js:291-367 implements elapsed difficulty, faster spawning, projectile collisions, score scaling, lives, and game-over behavior.
tests/game-core.test.mjs:28-50 covers collision detection and difficulty escalation; evidence/automated.json confirms enemy spawning and game-over state.

visual_design.rationale: The screenshots show a cohesive neon arcade identity, strong desktop hierarchy, effects, and responsive mobile controls. Two points are withheld because the mobile start overlay is visibly clipped and the screenshots do not show active combat feedback.
evidence: desktop-before.png and desktop-after.png visibly show the cyan/pink neon palette, outlined title, scanlined starfield, glowing ship, structured HUD, and leaderboard.
mobile.png visibly shows a stacked layout and usable directional/FIRE controls, but the start overlay copy is clipped within the short game stage.

src/style.css:1-19, 151-175, 267-305, and 638-827 defines the visual system, scanlines, responsive breakpoints, touch controls, and reduced-motion handling; src/main.js:235-250 and 359-527 implements particles, stars, glows, and enemy animation.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: The implementation covers loading, empty, missing-configuration, network-error, validation, focus, live-status, and reduced-motion paths.
evidence: src/main.js:554-592 handles missing configuration, loading, empty results, and leaderboard failures without disabling local play; src/main.js:696-721 validates submissions and restores retry ability after upload failure.
index.html:60-66, 79-122 provides canvas/form labels, live regions, focusable controls, and touch ARIA labels; src/style.css:66-71 and 818-827 provides focus-visible and reduced-motion rules.
evidence/automated.json records basic_accessible_labels with 7 labeled elements and browser_error_free with empty console/page error arrays.

data_security.rationale: The migration provides the required RLS, least-privilege grants/policies, and database-side validation, while the client exposes only a publishable key. The retained evaluator evidence includes a real remote read/write round trip.
evidence: supabase/migrations/20260807211810_create_leaderboard.sql:6-9 defines name and score constraints; lines 15-38 enable RLS, revoke broad access, grant only selected read/insert columns, and create select/insert policies.
src/config.js:1-4 contains only the Supabase URL and publishable key; a source-tree search found no service-role, management, or secret credential in application files.
evidence/automated.json:147-205 and 273-294 record remote Supabase GET 200, POST 201, and reload GET requests.

engineering_quality.rationale: Builds and tests pass, the lockfile is pinned, and pure gameplay/data helpers are tested. Credit is withheld for limited runtime/UI/DB test coverage, a broad 747-line main module, and no lint/typecheck script or retained logs.
evidence: evidence/build.log:2-5 reports a successful static build; evidence/test.log:5-17 reports 5 passing tests.
tests/game-core.test.mjs:12-56 covers name/score validation, collision geometry, difficulty, and score formatting.
package.json:6-13 defines test/build/check scripts and pins Wrangler; package-lock.json records the pinned dependency resolution.

src/main.js is a single 747-line module covering game state, rendering, audio, controls, networking, and the test adapter; the evidence directory contains build/test logs but no lint.log or typecheck.log.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff is reproducible beyond the result artifact: setup, controls, architecture, deployment, security decisions, migration, and pinned dependencies are documented and the source manifest retains the relevant files.
evidence: README.md:66-112 documents local setup, build/deploy commands, migration application, verification sequence, and security decisions.
supabase/migrations/20260807211810_create_leaderboard.sql is a checked-in schema/policy reproduction; package-lock.json pins the dependency graph.

evidence/source-manifest.txt:103-109, 183-186, and 420-427 lists the design, app source, package files, migration, tests, and Wrangler configuration; evidence/build.log and evidence/test.log provide reproducible command output.

summary: Manual evidence award: 42/46. Combined with the evaluator's 54/54 deterministic points, the evidence supports 96/100.
